title: Favourite genre per member
statementMd:
For each member with loans, show their most borrowed genre and the loan count (ties: alphabetically first genre).

Expected columns: `name`, `genre`, `n`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Count per member and genre, `ROW_NUMBER` ordered by count desc, genre.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH c AS (SELECT l.member_id, b.genre, COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id GROUP BY l.member_id, b.genre), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY n DESC, genre) AS rn FROM c) SELECT m.name, r.genre, r.n FROM r JOIN members m ON m.id = r.member_id WHERE r.rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
